title: Multiple Bunny vs the Superheroine
description:
You’re the most powerful superhero there is, but with a little help from my fellow villains, you’re not only trapped, you’re wearing a collar that removes your powers. That means… I’ve got you right where I want you. See, I think you could be a fantastic second in command. The brawn to my brains. But you need to see things my way first.

That’s where my superpower comes in. I can make copies of myself. Clones. Hot, sexy bunny clones. So it might be hard to follow the white rabbit, but you can try. Even as I keep on multiplying and you hear my voice all around you. Kissing, licking, touching you. Brainwashing you into submission as you give in to the pleasure of my voice and that hand between your thighs.

Art by Celyn, Ref, Kizuragi Rin & Rielilu.
author: Mistress Calia
